facts.fact: INTIC's report says it acts as National Cybersecurity Authority through the National CSIRT (CSIRT Nacional) under the national strategy.
The report says the national cybersecurity policy and strategy were approved by Resolution 69/2021 of 31 December.
facts.system: Politica e Estrategia Nacional de Seguranca Cibernetica

facts.fact: The report says the national risk assessment identified 29 critical information infrastructure systems from 18 institutions in five sectors; no register or operator reporting duty is stated.

note: Risk assessment is not incident handling, so no response fact.
